economics_route.desc: Flagship Red Sea luxury-belt excursion; provisional unit-economics anchor pending Jaideep's choice between Giftun and Ras Mohammed.

tam.headline: Two boat-only routes are the floor — the Red Sea day-trip market sits well above them

rungs.label: Two boat-only routes we can size today
rungs.note: Journey spend pool on Giftun + Ras Mohammed only (sourced visitors × day-trip fares). Navier revenue floor at ~90% captive capture is ~$7.65M. This is the FLOOR, not the market.

rungs.label: The wider Red Sea day-trip boat market (Hurghada alone)
rungs.note: Hurghada ~1.9M arrivals (2023, UNWTO) × labelled 35–55% reef/island day-trip participation × $32. Participation is an assumption band, not a sourced datum. Sharm and other Red Sea resorts are held upside on top of this.

rungs.label: Egypt marine-mobility opportunity
rungs.note: Red Sea day-trips (rung 2 + held resorts). Nile Luxor–Aswan transit and Alexandria waterfront are HELD NULL — no route-level boardings. Egypt ~15.8M arrivals / ~$15.3B tourism spend (2024, UNWTO) is context only, not a marine TAM number.
